dimensions.attack: Upstream RAID attack field; non-none values are adversarial derivatives.
dimensions.domain: Upstream RAID genre field. It is not a language or native-speaker assertion.
dimensions.generator: Upstream RAID model field: human or a named generator.
dimensions.label: Upstream model assertion mapped to human/generated; not universal authorship truth.
dimensions.language_hint: Coarse upstream-domain hint only (czech-domain, german-domain, or unknown). It is not a per-sample language assertion, and no runtime language override is frozen.
dimensions.length_bucket: Word-count bucket computed from the frozen sample bytes for reporting only.
dimensions.upstream_split: Upstream RAID split field (train or extra), not the nobotrs evaluation split.

language_policy.note: No frozen language overrides were designed. Default-runtime evaluation keeps the unknown-language policy; language_hint is only a coarse upstream-domain reporting dimension.

limitations: Only copied datasets-server filter views were available; every view is partial.
The pilot is not the complete RAID benchmark and must not be presented as one.
Rows are capped by the acquisition response length; available counts are much larger.
Only abstracts, books, czech, german, news, and poetry are represented.
Code, recipes, reddit, reviews, and wiki responses were absent, empty, or failed.
Most upstream domain/generator/attack cells were never requested or failed.
Only abstracts, books, and news contain GPT-4 paraphrase rows in this snapshot.
Some domains have no human cell (german and news) and some have no chatbot cell.
RAID supplies no native-speaker attribution, so none is inferred or reported.
RAID supplies no per-row language field, so language_hint is only a domain hint.
The detector runs with its default unknown-language policy; no overrides are frozen.
The 12 failed queries and empty responses are recorded, not filled or re-requested.
No RAID test split was requested; the pilot was built only from train/extra views.
Source IDs and exact/near content are grouped before splitting; no text is displayed.
purpose: Limited RAID pilot for development/validation plumbing and methodology. It is not the complete RAID benchmark, not independent accuracy certification, and held-out text is unopened.
